meta.purpose: Router-specific offline evaluation set for src/knowledge/selectiveRagRouter.js. SEPARATE from experiments/adaptive-routing/dataset.json (110 items / 118 turns), which is left untouched.
meta.labels: expected = DIRECT | GROUNDED | AMBIGUOUS. AMBIGUOUS exists for EVALUATION ONLY: the router itself must never emit it, and per the brief must resolve ambiguity toward GROUNDED. An AMBIGUOUS item is therefore scored correct if the router says GROUNDED, and a false-DIRECT if it says DIRECT.
meta.entities: All named producers/products are real entries from knowledge/entity-aliases.json (109 entities). Invented names are used ONLY in the unknown_entity category and are marked as such.
meta.severity: severity_class drives the weighted error score: 'high' = false DIRECT here is a severity-10 error (entity/product/price/availability/unknown-winery); 'low' = false GROUNDED here is a severity-2 error (general knowledge).
